Review Pension: Pension Plan Definitions / Characteristics

e "Guaranteed" Pension Plan — Retirees receive predetermined monthly retirement benefits from employers despite the funding status / investment returns of their pension funds. Also known as defined benefit pension plan.

e Defined Contribution Pension Plan — Retirees contribute specified amounts to their pension funds and receive variable monthly retirement benefits depending on investment returns. Examples include Individual Retirement Accounts (IRAs) and 401(k) plans.
